title: Decart publicly presented Lucy 2.5
summary: On 2026-07-18, Decart published a public page for Lucy 2.5 together with a linked public product endpoint. This is a material public development in the Lucy line because the dated official links identify a distinct version rather than a repost. The supplied links alone do not establish its precise capabilities, performance, availability, or relationship to earlier Lucy releases.
